root_cause.text: In the error path of pvrdma_alloc_ucontext(), pvrdma_uar_free() is called explicitly before pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext(), which itself calls pvrdma_uar_free(), resulting in a double-free of the UAR.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the explicit pvrdma_uar_free() call and adds a comment: "pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext() also frees the UAR". The CVE description directly states that calling it before triggers a double free.

intent_record.what: Replaced explicit call to pvrdma_uar_free with a comment in the error path of pvrdma_alloc_ucontext, keeping only the call to pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext.
intent_record.how: When ib_copy_to_udata fails, the error handler no longer calls pvrdma_uar_free separately; instead, it relies on pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext to also free the UAR, preventing a potential double-free or ensuring correct single cleanup.
